subject: Quick follow-up: POC outcomes + short quote / 10m check-in
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@cartwheel.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2029 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: POC outcomes + short quote / 10m check-in

Hi Emily —

Hope you're having a good afternoon. Now that the POC wrapped last week I wanted to share a concise outcomes recap and a small ask from the Redwood marketing team if you have a couple minutes. High level results from the 3-week POC (attached):

- Average tail-to-tail inference latency down ~45% (p95 from 640ms → 350ms)
- Per-1M-token inference cost reduced ~38% after batching/quantization tweaks
- Steady-state throughput improved ~3x under production-like concurrency
- Error rate (failed responses/timeouts) dropped from 1.6% → 0.4%

Huge thanks to you and the Cartwheel eng team for the tight feedback loop — those wins made product decisions much easier for us to tune.

If you're comfortable, would you be open to:
1) A quick 10–15 minute sync (we can do a calendar invite) to capture a 1–2 sentence quote for a short case blurb?
2) Permission to use Cartwheel's logo and a single anonymized metric (e.g., “45% latency reduction”) in a one-page result card?

We can keep the quote super-light — an ops or product line about the business impact (one sentence) and one line about reliability/engineering if that’s easier. 

Attaching the POC summary PDF and a dashboard screenshot for context. If you prefer, Marcus or Lauren can join the quick call.

Thanks again — and congrats on shipping the new recommendation flow!

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[t] +1 (415) 555-0187
